title.zh: 为司法部检察司增设检察官，扩充并重组其检察人员编制并为其他目的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for Additional Prosecutors in the Prosecution Division of the Department of Justice, Enlarging and Reorganizing its Prosecution Staff, and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Providing for Additional Prosecutors in the Prosecution Division of the Department of Justice, Enlarging and Reorganizing its Prosecution Staff, and for Other Purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_5184_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, the members of the Prosecution Staff and complementary personnel as hereinabove provided shall receive the salary rates provided for in this Act: Provided , That no prosecutor, attorney or employee of the merged prosecution services at the time of the approval of this Act shall, as a consequence of the operation of this Act, be removed or separated from the service except for cause as provided by law: Provided, further , That the Secretary of Justice shall determine and establish the respective positions, rank and salaries of the incumbent state prosecutors and personnel: Provided, further , That no incumbent prosecutor or personnel shall be demoted in rank and salary: Provided, finally , That the incumbent prosecutors, attorneys and personnel shall receive their salary adjustments without the need of any new appointment.

In addition to such sums as may have been provided in the current Appropriations Act, there is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: September 8, 1967
